titleTh: หมวด 3 — สัญญาข้อมูลตามหลักการ (Canonical Data Contracts)
note: Static-only canonical data contracts for Category 3 (การใช้ทรัพยากรและพลังงาน). Each contract models the frozen FY2568 historical baseline only, using only C1-approved mappings and fy2568-publication.json manifest references/hashes. All 15 indicators (3.1.1–3.4.2) have dedicated content-verified evidence — no GAP/MISSING indicator. 3.2.2 is MEDIUM strength (per-unit electricity tables are image-only); 2 scans, the garbled measures PDF (#3), misbounded #19, incomplete #21/#32, and the absent signed copy are honestly disclosed. No invented OCR, signature, approval, score, or FY2569 data. evidenceIds reference the C3 evidence-index entries with matching manifest path/hash/availability.

contracts.note: Cross-indicator FY2568 target clauses (electricity/water/fuel/paper each reduce 1% vs 2024) from the canonical เป้าหมาย/ตัวชี้วัด/มาตรการ 68 docx (#4). Category-level evidence by design (spans all 15 indicators).

Resource conservation measures (water/electricity/fuel/paper/ink). 3.4.1 green-meeting measures live in meetings.json to avoid a duplicate registry. Scans (AC condensate #11, vehicle log #20) are filename_folder_only, not promoted.

Per-unit measurement data vs target with analysis: water 8,337.50 u (+47.1%), electricity 403,036.80 u (+4.6%), fuel 695.82 L (−22.7% MET), paper 2,197.80 kg (+5.6%). 3.2.2 per-unit values unavailable (image-only tables).
Behavioral compliance surveys in work areas (water/electricity/paper/ink).
Green meetings/exhibitions: eco measures (3.4.1) + eco-material implementation (3.4.2, partial in standalone #32; complete content in the #29 DOCX report).

sourceLimitations.note: #11 ปริมาณน้ำทั้งเครื่องปรับอากาศ.pdf — 12-page image-only scan (filename_folder_only), content not verifiable without OCR.
#20 รายงานการใช้รถยนต์.pdf — 22-page image-only scanned vehicle-use log (filename_folder_only), content not verifiable without OCR.
#3 มาตรการควบคุมการใช้พลังงานและทรัพยากร ปี 68.pdf — Thai text garbled in extraction (broken font cmap); visually readable only, details pending OCR review.
3.2.2 per-unit electricity tables and water monthly charts are image-only; only summary numbers (403,036.80 u, +4.6%; 8,337.50 u, +47.1%) are text-verifiable. 3.2.2 is MEDIUM strength.
#19 (3.2.4.pdf) is misbounded: starts with a 3.2.3 page and ends with 3.2.5 pages; fuel measures on pages 2–9.
#21 (3.2.5.pdf) begins at item (2); item (1) exists in the compiled 3.2 reports (#14/#15).
#32 (3.4.2.pdf) starts at item (3), missing items (1)/(2); complete 3.4.2 content exists in the #29 DOCX report.
No file in the FY2568 Cat3 set contains a signature/approval block; #4 carries a typed-name placeholder only. No signed/approved submission copy is claimed.
